COMPLETION BY A RANK-DEFICIENT QUADRATIC AND AN ACTUAL CAPACITY JUMP
31 October 2026. Exact algebra, analytic proof, and internal replay.

Keep the fixed non-aligned Hopf quartic F from ../hopf_structure and
its full twelve-dimensional admissible cubic space V. Put

                     Q0(a,b,c,d)=b^2+c^2.

NEW BOUNDARY COMPLETION THEOREM

There is an explicit four-dimensional subspace N of ALL twenty cubics
such that the following statements are equivalent, for every cubic C:

 (i)   F+C+nu Q0 is globally rank-one convex for some finite nu;
 (ii)  F+C+nu Q0 is globally quasiconvex for some finite nu;
 (iii) C belongs to N.

The literal rational basis C1,...,C4 in certificate.json has coefficient
l1 norm one in each column. A universal sufficient choice, for
C=sum t_j C_j, is

                      nu=2^86 (sum |t_j|)^2.                (1)

No nonzero element of N is a translation cubic DF.h. This is a new
quadratic boundary family: Q0 is zero on span(E11,E22). It cannot be
obtained from the retained 4096 seed by its listed cone operations,
whose completed ROC slack has the positive charge-dependent lower
bound in ../gradient_compatibility/CLOSURE_BARRIER.txt.

The theorem classifies completion along multiples of this particular
quadratic. It does not classify all quadratics in the full face, resolve
QC of the 1859 fixture, or give a general ROC/QC equivalence. The bound
in (1) is a deliberately loose existence bound, with no numerical
advantage asserted. The leading heat certificate is reused and fully
re-received; this is an internal mathematical certificate.

1. THE EXACT NECESSARY CUBIC SPACE

Write K1=A0 and K2=(-b0,a0;1,-c0), as in the acquired source. For
u=(x,y), U_u=(x,-y;y,x), let R_i(u)=u tensor e_i. Membership in V is
